vocab.simpleEn: happening regularly in the same way
vocab.exampleEn: Consistent practice is more useful than one long study session.
vocab.exampleZh: 持续练习比一次性长时间学习更有用。
vocab.upgradeEn: Use consistent practice, consistent effort, and consistent improvement.
vocab.upgradeZh: 常用搭配：consistent practice / effort / improvement。

cycle.summaryEn: Use short sets to build speed, focus, and calm under pressure.
cycle.summaryZh: 用短小测练速度、专注和压力下的稳定性。

frame.useEn: Use this to answer clearly and naturally.
frame.useZh: 用来让口语回答更清楚自然。

meaningEn: This study word helps Becky talk about learning and progress more precisely.
meaningZh: 这个学习词可以帮助 Becky 更准确地表达学习和进步。
promptEn: China drill: read the Chinese meaning, shadow the example twice, then make one Becky-style sentence with "consistent" using What I mean is...
promptZh: 中文母语者练法：先看中文意思，跟读例句两遍，再用 "consistent" 和 我的意思是... 写一句 Becky 自己的话。
sourceEn: This harder word is auto-picked for Becky and refreshes every day with a China-friendly output drill.
sourceZh: 这个高分词会每天自动为 Becky 刷新，并配中文母语者适用的输出练习。
